what: A Discussion paragraph quoted centre B accuracy as 95.4%, a value from an earlier draft of results.md. The final value is 95.8%. (Invented for illustration.)
root_cause: Numbers were typed into the Discussion from memory of an earlier results draft instead of copied from the current results.md.
prevention: Before accepting any Discussion or abstract unit, check that every percentage in its logic.json numbers list has matches_results true. Global-aligner fails a unit with any false value.
